messages.author: Michael F. Bruist
messages.body:
Hi,
Links for tutorials C2 through C5 all lead to dead ends. Have addresses changed, or is there some maintenance happening?
Mike Bruist

messages.author: David Cerutti
messages.body:
Can you be more specific on what tutorials those are referring to? I can
scan through the links that are on the webpage, but none of them are named
C2-C5 anymore. There were A- and B-class tutorials at one point, and if
you look under the "advanced" and "basic" folders in the actual directory
you can still find this nomenclature for some of the names, but the list
was revised some years ago to make it more intuitive and do away with the
letter designations.
Dave

messages.author: Michael F. Bruist
messages.body:
David,
Yes, I was referring to the cpptraj tutorials. I tried accessing them again and I was able to see all of them. I may have been on an old tutorial page that I got to through the AMBER mailing list archives. This time I went directly through AMBERmd.org. Thanks for your help.
Mike Bruist
